title: Transport And Survival
description: Transport & Survival is vision of me to add stuff on Minecraft
body:
This is the description of this mod !wow!
Before start with all, !Take this like a warning!
The mod currently at the prerelease version it's only in spanish. Only in the major updates the mod are gone to be in spanish & english.

_English_
Transport & Survival is a mod that adds quite a lot off things to minecraft 1.20.1 The mod adds minerals like: Tin, Indium, Ruby, Lead, Sapphire.
Adds food like: pizza, mushrooms, ice cream.
And diferents types of biomes with their wood: Maze, Extorsial, Red Leaves, Holm oak, Green Stick Tree.

_Español_
Transport & Survival es un mod que añade muchas cosas para minecraft 1.20.1 El mod añade minerales como: Estaño, Indio, Rubí, Plomo, Zafiro.
Añade más comida como: pizza, hongos, helado.
Y diferentes tipos de biomas con sus tipos de maderas: Maze, Extorsial, Red Leaves, Encina, Árbol de Palo Verde.
